LESSON: PUPPETRY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.4: Puppetry

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Puppetry
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why are features of a puppet exaggerated?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify a glove puppet for familiarisation
2. perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify a glove puppet for familiarisation

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify a glove puppet for familiarisation.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify a glove puppet for familiarisation” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify a glove puppet for familiarisation” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify a glove puppet for familiarisation" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment

Teach
• Today’s focus: perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment” using a school example.
• Model B for “perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify a glove puppet for familiarisation
• Model 2: perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify a glove puppet for familiarisation
2. Practise: perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Puppetry.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are features of a puppet exaggerated?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify a glove puppet for familiarisation
• perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
